settings.title: Which SIHOO chair is best for most people?
settings.answer: For a home office used four to eight hours a day, the M57 (adjustable lumbar, 3D armrests, headrest, 150 kg) is the best-value all-rounder. If you sit longer, or want self-adjusting lumbar support and a 5-year warranty, step up to the Doro C300 Pro V2 or Doro S300.

settings.title: How do I use the user-height column?
settings.answer: Pick a chair whose range covers your height with some margin at both ends. If you are near the top of a range, prefer a model with a higher seat-height maximum and an adjustable headrest; near the bottom, prefer a lower minimum seat height and adjustable seat depth.

settings.title: What does the recline column mean?
settings.answer: The angles are the positions the backrest can lock at. Chairs listed with two angles recline freely between them; chairs with three or four angles lock at each step.

settings.title: Where are the chairs shipped from?
settings.answer: From the SIHOO Australia warehouse nearest you – Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane or Perth. Orders are dispatched the next business day and usually arrive within 1–3 business days; delivery is free Australia-wide.
